labels: Exact / Observed / Simulated / Inferred / Rejected / Open
limitations: bounded deterministic Moore worlds (<= 4 states, 2 actions, 2 bits); i.i.d. observation flips; 88-step traces; not general intelligence

method.api: brute.certify/10: method 'stitched' is new; 'lr' = /9 and 'anytime' = /8, unchanged. /9 to /1 carried.
method.definition: Within epoch k (steps in (28*2^(k-1), 28*2^k], with epoch 0 = steps 1-28), apply the planned-horizon LR threshold for H_k=28*2^k at confidence delta_k=delta/((k+1)(k+2)). A certificate, once issued, is kept only while every later epoch's test also holds. Same family bound, burn-in, eps_bar and delta=0.01 as RGL4.
method.lemma_first: An exact union-bound lemma (sum of delta_k <= delta) and a DP reference implementation are committed and ledgered before any RGL5 code.

motivation.hypothesis: Stitching the LR bound over a geometric grid of horizons, with delta_k proportional to 1/((k+1)(k+2)), recovers most of the planned-horizon margin and stays anytime-valid (Open).
motivation.observed_v0200: RGL4 sound (0/240 noisy false; CP95 0.0124), C_late 0.417 at eps 0.02, but it trails planned-B RGNB4 (0.530; dC -0.113 [-0.155,-0.073]). C_early28 is about 0 for every robust arm (RGL4 0.0024). G_HB FAIL (6 gaps over 10 s). GCC FAIL (#112). False-start orchestrator (#111). Frozen verifier bug (#113). Hand-typed ledger times (#114).

non_gated_reports.early_window_diagnostic: For steps <= 28, report the minimum number of consistent observations a robust arm needs to certify a bit, against what each trace supplies (explains C_early28 about 0; Open).
non_gated_reports.host_pause_probe: A 10-minute heartbeat-only probe before run_start records host pauses; reported next to G_HB and never used to excuse it.
